channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 25 November
item.description: Security threat verification was added and session records were corrected in the blockchain network, while the cognitive system locked its builds to self‑hosted runners. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusCognitiveSystem, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 24 November
item.description: Further testing corrections and dispatch upgrades were applied to the blockchain platform, a new architecture‑review capability was added to the cognitive system, and developer tools received refreshed code models. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, thirdparty, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 23 November
item.description: The blockchain platform fixed iOS testing issues and updated dispatch processes, and a small test fix was applied to the cognitive system. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-client-scaffold.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 22 November
item.description: The wallet application fixed startup messages and improved rename handling, and the blockchain platform addressed record cleanup and a funding reservation leak. Repositories: GeniusWallet, SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 21 November
item.description: The blockchain system added support for recovering certificate data and fixed issues with held transactions, accompanied by extensive testing and documentation updates. Repositories: SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 20 November
item.description: The blockchain platform received new downgrade controls, fixes for restart handling, and several testing updates, while the cognitive system added a concurrency test improvement and developer tools were refreshed with a hardening review. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusSDK.
